correction_reason: V1 preserved accepted raw BID/ASK architecture but did not separate stale PRE-boundary quotes from fresh POST-boundary executable quotes and did not contract-bind resume state.
purpose: Minimum generic candidate-independent historical BID/ASK evidence for Tier-1 C006/C012 Discovery cost readiness; no candidate PnL/signals/returns are consulted.

reference_calendar.raw_capture_rule: RAW REQUESTS REMAIN ALL WEEKDAY 09:30-16:00 ET ENVELOPES, INCLUDING HOLIDAYS/EARLY-CLOSE TAILS, SO NO RETURNED QUOTE IS REMOVED OR FABRICATED

acquisition_domain.holidays: RAW ENVELOPE STILL REQUESTED; EMPTY BROKER RESPONSE IS PRESERVED
acquisition_domain.early_closes: RAW REGULAR ENVELOPE STILL REQUESTED; DERIVED BOUNDARIES STOP AT OFFICIAL EARLY CLOSE

spread_reconstruction.current_bid: latest BID observation <= event time only
spread_reconstruction.current_ask: latest ASK observation <= event time only
spread_reconstruction.generic_boundaries: EVERY OFFICIAL M15 BOUNDARY FROM SESSION OPEN THROUGH SESSION CLOSE INCLUSIVE, INCLUDING 09:30

PRE_BOUNDARY.definition: latest causally formed two-sided quote state with state timestamp <= boundary
PRE_BOUNDARY.role: closing/pre-event context; may be stale and MUST NOT automatically price MARKET_PROXY entry

POST_BOUNDARY_EXECUTABLE.definition: first causally formed two-sided quote state at or after boundary for which BOTH bid and ask have each been observed at or after that boundary
POST_BOUNDARY_EXECUTABLE.rationale: Prospectively frozen one-M15 generic execution-evidence window independent of candidate signals/PnL. A stale opposite side cannot make a post-boundary executable state.

session_close_boundary.POST_BOUNDARY_EXECUTABLE: NOT_USED_FOR_COMPLETED_BAR_CLOSE_COST; any after-close quote remains distinct and is not mixed with the close boundary

resume_contract_binding.mismatch_policy: ARCHIVE OLD VERSIONED WORK DIRECTORY AND START EMPTY; NEVER REUSE CHUNKS ACROSS CONTRACT MISMATCH
